ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels dominate approximately 90% of the visible surface, punctuated by a high frequency of isolated high-intensity (white) pixel clusters representing a roughly 1:10 ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Stochastic distribution of small high-intensity blobs (speckling) across the entire ventral plane. Concentrated high-intensity geometric clusters are visible at the distal extremities (tips) of both lobes. A distinct contiguous white patch is mapped at the extreme left tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped notch with a calculated internal angle of approximately 65 degrees and a moderate depth-to-width ratio relative to the medial fluke line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, non-uniform serration pattern along the entire continuous trailing edge. Pixel-amplitude of peaks increases significantly toward the distal tips, presenting as sharp, jagged protrusions.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted to the trailing edges of both lobes, transitioning to a sharp upward sweep at the distal margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, multi-tonal (brown and white) pixel groups localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, consistent with external calcified attachments.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple unaligned, high-intensity linear marks visible. Notable vertical-oblique disruption located on the lower-mid quadrant of the right lobe, and several horizontal-oblique marks on the mid-section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense calcified clusters (barnacles) at both lobe tips causing significant local edge deformation and texture variance.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely high density of micro-mottling (white spots) across the dark pigmented field, creating a high-frequency 'salt-and-pepper' visual texture.
